notes: Round-2 held-out questions, written by hand with read-only git (git show/log/diff -M/tag --contains) AFTER round-1 (E2) results were seen; disjoint from every round-1 question in evals/repo_questions/*.json. No rw.repo output was consulted. Do not edit after any run: changes require a new evaluation retaining the originals. expected_facts holds the concrete answer (values are Python literals; `first_tag_containing` is the earliest tag matching the repo's tag_pattern whose commit has the fix commit as an ancestor; fix `state` is judged on content). Shas are those produced by the deterministic builder.

questions.question: At v1.0.0, what is the value of MAX_WEIGHT_KG?
At v1.1.0, which carriers does CARRIERS list?
At v1.0.0, what is TIMEOUT_S?
questions.expected_answer: The expression 2 * 5 (= 10), not a plain literal (ship/limits.py line 4).

questions.question: At v1.2.0, which exceptions can ship.quote.check_weight raise?
At v1.4.0, which exceptions can ship.quote.check_weight raise?
questions.expected_answer: Only OverweightError (line 7); the ValueError check was dropped in v1.4.0.

questions.question: Is fix efbad9e1 (reject negative weights, #3) present at v1.3.0, and which tag first contains it?
questions.expected_answer: PRESENT (ship/quote.py lines 6-7 at v1.3.0); the fix commit is untagged and first ships in v1.2.0.

questions.question: Is fix efbad9e1 (reject negative weights, #3) still present at v1.4.0?
questions.expected_answer: ABSENT: the commit is an ancestor, but v1.4.0 removed the check by hand (ship/quote.py check_weight lines 5-8 has no negative test). First tag containing the commit: v1.2.0.

questions.question: What changed between v1.2.0 and v1.3.0?
questions.expected_answer: ship/fmt.py renamed (with edit, similarity 51%) to ship/labels.py, adding ship.labels.short; ship/track.py deleted, removing ship.track.track; CHANGELOG.md modified.

questions.question: When did ship.track.track appear and disappear?
questions.expected_answer: First present at v1.1.0 (absent at v1.0.0); first absent at v1.3.0 (ship/track.py deleted).

questions.question: At v1.0.0, what does ship.quote.quote depend on?
questions.expected_answer: ship.quote.check_weight (call, line 16) and ship.errors.ShipError (raised, line 15); reads ship.limits.CARRIERS.
